title: powerSaveBlocker.isStarted immediately returns false for a new blocker
body: On macOS with Electron 42.2.0, after app.whenReady(), powerSaveBlocker.start("prevent-app-suspension") returns an integer id but isStarted(id) is already false. No stop call has occurred. A minimal main-process-only script prints false; the same sequence printed true before upgrading.

title: Power monitor misses a resume event after laptop lid opens
body: The powerMonitor module receives suspend but misses resume after a lid wake. Blocker start and isStarted work normally; this concerns wake notifications.
